newsitem.title: FRANCE: Earthquake jolts Algiers but no damage.
newsitem.headline: Earthquake jolts Algiers but no damage.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 5.7 on the Richter scale rocked Algiers on Wednesday but there were no reports of casualties or serious damage, the Algerian state-run radio said.
The tremor, at 5.15 a.m. (0415 GMT), rattled windows and prompted many people to leave their homes in fear of collapsing buildings, residents of the Algerian capital said by telephone.
The epicentre was 35 km (22 miles) northwest of Algiers, the national earthquake research centre said.
